title: IGPX: Immortal Grand Prix
justification: Checked by episode title against TVDB series 73011 and TMDB show 34690. Its episodes are on TMDB show 34690. AniDB episode 1-5 ("Episode 1" to "Episode 5") are TVDB S0E1 "Part 1" to TVDB S0E5 "Part 5" and TMDB S1E1 "Part 1" to TMDB S1E5 "Part 5"; AniDB S1-S5 ("Movie version" to "Interview Lance Henriksen as Andrei") have no TVDB episode (their defaults are other items) and no TMDB episode (TMDB has none of them); AniDB S6-S8 ("Interview Mark Hamill as Yamma" to "Interview Sean Akins and Jason Demarco Co-writers and Co-Producers") have no TVDB episode (TVDB has none of them) and no TMDB episode (TMDB has none of them). The five 2003 parts are TVDB season 0 "Part 1" to "Part 5", one a day like AniDB's, the only such run on the show; TMDB show 34690 is that run. The DVD extras have no episode on either side.
